entries.headline: Taiwan CDC adds Novavax to public COVID-19 programme from October 19
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Novavax (Nuvaxovid) joins the public COVID-19 offer from 19 October, and CDC says it plans additional flu and Novavax doses. Wide pickup frames it as a protein-based option arriving next week.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗接種
entries.why_zh: 公費：Novavax（Nuvaxovid）自10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗選項，疾管署並表示計畫增購流感及Novavax疫苗。媒體廣泛報導，將其定位為下週到貨的蛋白質疫苗選項。

entries.headline: CDC fully draws open contracts, orders about 474,000 extra public doses
entries.why: Public programme (公費): most outlets report 300,000 flu and 174,000 COVID-19 doses, with delivery expected in early November. Some reports attribute the 174,000 to flu instead, so the split needs confirmation.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署全數動用開口契約，增購約47.4萬劑公費疫苗
entries.why_zh: 公費：多數媒體報導為流感疫苗30萬劑、COVID-19疫苗17.4萬劑，預計11月初到貨。部分報導則將17.4萬劑歸為流感疫苗，劑數分配仍待確認。

entries.headline: Weekly flu toll of 144 severe cases and 46 deaths drives vaccine rush
entries.why: This affects both arenas. Outlets describe severe cases and deaths at five-year or record highs, about 2.26 million flu doses given in 10 days, and public worry about shortages. That puts pressure on both public supply and clinic stock.
entries.headline_zh: 單週流感重症144例、死亡46例，引發接種潮
entries.why_zh: 此事同時影響公費與自費兩端。媒體形容重症及死亡數創五年或歷史新高，10天內已接種約226萬劑流感疫苗，民眾擔憂缺貨，對公費供應與診所庫存均造成壓力。

entries.headline: Fact-check: publicly funded enhanced flu vaccine is not an mRNA vaccine
entries.why: Public programme (公費): a fact-checker rated misleading an online rumour that ties the first public enhanced flu vaccines to mRNA. Opinion columns meanwhile frame the enhanced rollout as an ageing-society strategy.
entries.headline_zh: 事實查核：公費加強型流感疫苗並非mRNA疫苗
entries.why_zh: 公費：查核機構將一則把首批公費加強型流感疫苗與mRNA連結的網路謠言判定為誤導。另有評論專欄將加強型疫苗推動定位為高齡社會策略。

entries.headline: Self-pay cost burden surfaces; Rotary club urges subsidies for vulnerable elderly
entries.why: Self-pay market (自費): one report frames out-of-pocket vaccination as a heavy burden for older people outside eligibility. Separately, a pregnant poster notes paying herself for an RSV shot and being told the price rises after birth.
entries.headline_zh: 自費負擔議題浮現；扶輪社呼籲補助弱勢長者
entries.why_zh: 自費：一篇報導指出，未符合資格的長者自費接種負擔沉重。另有一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會上漲。

entries.headline: Viral anti-COVID-19 vaccine anecdote about a 'clean' lung CT draws high engagement
entries.why: A Threads post (about 8,500 engagements) implies being unvaccinated is healthier. Smaller posts claim vaccines don't cut transmission or cause heart disease. These are unverified posts, not linked to any brand.
entries.headline_zh: 反COVID-19疫苗「肺部CT很乾淨」軼事爆紅，互動量高
entries.why_zh: 一則Threads貼文（約8,500次互動）暗示未接種疫苗較健康。其他較小貼文聲稱疫苗無法降低傳播或會導致心臟病。這些皆為未經查證的貼文，未涉及任何品牌。

watch.text: Novavax public COVID-19 vaccination starts; watch site availability, uptake reporting and any early safety chatter.
watch.text_zh: Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗開打；留意接種點供應、接種數據及早期安全性討論。

watch.text: Second stage of the public flu programme opens to more groups while top-up doses are still in transit.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開放更多對象，增購疫苗仍在運送中。

watch.text: Expected arrival of about 474,000 top-up doses; watch for confirmation of the flu/COVID-19 split and any shortage stories before then.
watch.text_zh: 約47.4萬劑增購疫苗預計到貨；在此之前留意流感/COVID-19劑數分配確認及缺貨報導。

qa.q: Will the top-up orders close the supply gap before the second stage?
qa.a: CDC says open contracts are fully drawn: about 474,000 doses, mostly reported as 300,000 flu and 174,000 COVID-19, arriving early November. One outlet already reports public fear of shortages, so expect gap stories until then.
qa.q_zh: 增購能否在第二階段前補足供應缺口？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署表示開口契約已全數動用：約47.4萬劑，多數報導為流感30萬劑、COVID-19 17.4萬劑，11月初到貨。已有媒體報導民眾擔憂缺貨，預期到貨前缺口相關報導將持續。

qa.q: Is anything happening on enhanced (adjuvanted / high-dose) flu vaccines this week?
qa.a: Enhanced-flu conversation fell sharply (28 items vs 95 the prior week). Coverage was limited to opinion columns on the ageing-society strategy and a fact-check rejecting an mRNA rumour. No item states whether the top-ups include enhanced doses.
qa.q_zh: 本週加強型（含佐劑／高劑量）流感疫苗有何動態？
qa.a_zh: 加強型流感疫苗討論量大幅下降（28則，前一週95則）。報導僅限於高齡社會策略評論專欄，以及駁斥mRNA謠言的事實查核。無任何內容說明增購是否包含加強型疫苗。

qa.q: Is misinformation currently aimed at a specific brand?
qa.a: No. The live claims target COVID-19 vaccines generically: the viral lung-CT anecdote, transmission and heart-disease claims, and a resurgence conspiracy. The flu-related rumour (enhanced vaccine as mRNA) has already been fact-checked.
qa.q_zh: 目前錯誤訊息是否針對特定品牌？
qa.a_zh: 否。現行說法泛指COVID-19疫苗：爆紅的肺部CT軼事、傳播與心臟病說法，以及疫情復燃陰謀論。流感相關謠言（加強型疫苗為mRNA）已經事實查核。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: An early CDC readout of higher-than-last-year uptake set up the demand narrative that led to the top-up orders.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署早期公布接種率高於去年，奠定需求敘事，進而促成增購。

policy_notes.why: Adds Novavax to the public COVID-19 offer from 19 October and signals extra flu and Novavax procurement, the week's most consequential programme change.
policy_notes.why_zh: 10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗，並釋出增購流感及Novavax疫苗訊號，為本週影響最大的計畫變動。

misinfo.claim: An unvaccinated mother's 'very clean' lung CT shows skipping COVID-19 vaccination is healthier
misinfo.note: High-engagement anecdote. Keep evidence summaries ready and route any response through fact-checkers or medical societies rather than brand channels.
misinfo.claim_zh: 未接種疫苗的母親肺部CT「非常乾淨」，證明不打COVID-19疫苗較健康
misinfo.note_zh: 高互動軼事。備妥證據摘要，任何回應應透過事實查核機構或醫學會，而非品牌管道。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccination does not prevent infection or transmission, so vaccinated people are no different
misinfo.note: Recurring framing. Track whether it attaches to the new public offer and defer to official CDC messaging.
misinfo.claim_zh: 接種COVID-19疫苗無法預防感染或傳播，因此接種者與未接種者無異
misinfo.note_zh: 反覆出現的論述。追蹤是否與新的公費選項連結，並以疾管署官方訊息為準。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines cause myocarditis, heart attacks and heart disease
misinfo.note: Low reach; users are already countering it with published incidence data. Keep regulator-sourced safety data accessible to stakeholders.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗導致心肌炎、心臟病發作及心臟疾病
misinfo.note_zh: 觸及有限；已有使用者以公開發生率數據反駁。確保利害關係人可取得主管機關來源的安全性數據。

misinfo.claim: Virus resurgences in Hong Kong, South Korea and mainland China were caused by vaccines
misinfo.note: Conspiracy content amplified from a known promoter's livestream; minimal engagement, no action beyond tracking.
misinfo.claim_zh: 香港、南韓及中國大陸疫情復燃是疫苗造成
misinfo.note_zh: 陰謀論內容源自知名推廣者直播並被轉傳；互動極少，僅需追蹤。

misinfo.claim: Taiwan's publicly funded enhanced flu vaccine is an mRNA vaccine
misinfo.note: Already rated misleading by a fact-checker. Be ready to point stakeholders to the fact-check and TFDA licensing information if it resurfaces in long-term care settings.
misinfo.claim_zh: 台灣公費加強型流感疫苗是mRNA疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 已被查核機構判定為誤導。若在長照場域再度出現，準備引導利害關係人參考該查核報告及食藥署許可資訊。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV mentions roughly tripled week on week (33 vs 12), but nothing this week names nirsevimab or infant antibodies; the visible RSV item is a pregnant user's post about paying out of pocket for a maternal RSV shot and being told the price would be higher after birth.
products.implication: Infant RSV protection is surfacing mainly as a parental cost question in the self-pay arena, and the maternal-versus-newborn pathway is being discussed by parents without an authoritative frame.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence and policy brief on infant RSV protection pathways and burden for discussions with paediatric and obstetric experts, and monitor parent forums for cost and access questions without engaging consumers directly.
products.signal_zh: RSV提及量較上週約成長三倍（33則，前週12則），但本週無內容提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體；可見的RSV內容為一名孕婦發文表示自費接種孕期RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV保護主要以家長費用疑問形式出現在自費領域，孕婦接種與新生兒保護兩種途徑由家長自行討論，缺乏權威框架。
products.action_zh: 準備中立的嬰兒RSV保護途徑與疾病負擔證據及政策簡報，供與兒科及婦產科專家討論；並監測家長論壇的費用與可近性問題，不直接與消費者互動。
who_zh: 婦產科醫師及產科診所
疾管署預防接種政策人員

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose mentions fell (12 vs 23), but opinion columns used the first public enhanced flu batch as a case for super-aged-society strategy, a fact-check stated the public enhanced flu vaccine is not mRNA, and several top-up stories referenced enhanced vaccines without saying whether extra enhanced doses were ordered. A Hong Kong outlet ran an efficacy-framed piece on a recombinant high-antigen vaccine for elders.
products.implication: The policy argument for widening enhanced-vaccine access is being made by commentators, while mRNA rumours and cross-market efficacy-framed content create accuracy and advertising-rule sensitivities.
products.action: Assemble an evidence and budget-impact pack on older-adult flu burden for advisory and legislative stakeholders ahead of next season's tender, and keep a factual Q&A ready on the vaccine's technology (not mRNA) for health bureaus and journalists who ask.
who: Taiwan CDC and immunisation advisory committee
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），65歲以上長照機構住民公費接種
products.signal_zh: 高劑量提及量下降（12則，前週23則），但評論專欄以首批公費加強型流感疫苗為例論述超高齡社會策略，事實查核指出公費加強型流感疫苗並非mRNA，多則增購報導提及加強型疫苗但未說明是否增購。一家香港媒體刊出以效力為訴求、介紹長者用重組高抗原疫苗的文章。
products.implication_zh: 擴大加強型疫苗可近性的政策論述由評論者提出，而mRNA謠言及跨市場效力訴求內容，則帶來資訊正確性與廣告法規上的敏感度。
products.action_zh: 在下一季採購招標前，彙整長者流感疾病負擔的證據與預算衝擊資料，提供給諮詢委員及立法相關利害關係人；並備妥說明該疫苗技術（非mRNA）的事實Q&A，供衛生局及記者詢問時使用。
who_zh: 疾管署及預防接種諮詢委員會
老年醫學及感染症專家
衛生政策評論者及立委助理

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Very little this week: Tdap volume is small (7 vs 5 mentions) and no current news or social item addresses Tdap or pertussis; the only related storyline, a medical-society appeal on vaccines for chronic lung disease, had no new mentions in the last 7 days.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from a respiratory conversation dominated by flu and COVID-19, so there is no live issue but also no visibility.
products.action: No reactive action needed; keep a background evidence file on adult and maternal pertussis protection ready for expert and society engagement when respiratory-season discussions widen.
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週極少：Tdap聲量很小（7則，前週5則），目前無新聞或社群內容涉及Tdap或百日咳；唯一相關議題為醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗，近7天無新提及。
products.implication_zh: 在流感與COVID-19主導的呼吸道討論中，Tdap缺席，因此雖無即時議題，但也缺乏能見度。
products.action_zh: 無需回應行動；備妥成人及孕婦百日咳保護的背景證據資料，待呼吸道季節討論擴大時與專家及學會互動。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi, public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced that a publicly funded Novavax COVID-19 vaccine made by a different process will be offered from October 19 and that more Novavax doses are planned; multiple outlets relayed the start date and new supply.
products.implication: The October 19 start opens a period of high visibility in the public programme, where local availability, clinic readiness and early post-vaccination posts will shape perception.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC on delivery and allocation timing, give local health bureaus and contracted clinics a factual availability and storage Q&A, and set up monitoring for first-week posts about access or reactions.
who: Health reporters covering the joint campaign
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質疫苗，台灣由Sanofi代理，10月19日起公費接種
products.signal_zh: 疾管署宣布以不同製程生產的公費Novavax COVID-19疫苗將於10月19日起提供，並計畫增購Novavax；多家媒體轉述開打日期與新供貨。
products.implication_zh: 10月19日開打將開啟公費計畫的高曝光期，地方供應、診所準備度及早期接種後貼文將形塑觀感。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署協調配送及配發時程，提供地方衛生局及合約院所供應與儲存事實Q&A，並建立首週可近性或接種反應貼文監測。
who_zh: 報導聯合接種活動的衛生線記者

issues.title: Novavax public rollout start and local availability questions
issues.note: Taiwan CDC set the start date and plans more doses; expect questions on which sites have stock and early reaction posts in the first week.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費開打與地方供應疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署已訂開打日期並計畫增購；預期首週出現哪些接種點有疫苗的詢問及早期反應貼文。

issues.title: Shortage perception before top-up doses arrive and second stage opens
issues.note: Reports say the 474,000 extra public doses arrive in early November, as the second stage begins 2026-11-02, and one outlet reports public fears of shortage driving a rush.
issues.title_zh: 增購疫苗到貨及第二階段開放前的缺貨觀感
issues.note_zh: 據報47.4萬劑增購公費疫苗於11月初到貨，與2026-11-02第二階段開放時間相近；已有媒體報導民眾擔憂缺貨而湧入接種。

issues.title: COVID-19 misinformation and reaction posts amplifying with uptake
issues.note: A lung-CT anecdote drew about 8,500 engagements and other posts recycle heart and resurgence claims; a parent post on infant reactions to a public flu dose shows how individual experiences travel.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19錯誤訊息及反應貼文隨接種量擴散
issues.note_zh: 肺部CT軼事約獲8,500次互動，其他貼文重提心臟及疫情復燃說法；一則家長分享嬰兒接種公費流感疫苗反應的貼文，顯示個人經驗的傳播力。

self_pay.title: Self-pay cost burden for older adults
self_pay.note: A Rotary club, reported in the press, called self-paid vaccination costs a heavy burden and urged subsidies for vulnerable elders outside the eligible groups; the item concerns COVID-19 vaccination.
self_pay.note_zh: 媒體報導某扶輪社指自費接種費用負擔沉重，呼籲補助不符資格的弱勢長者；此事涉及COVID-19疫苗接種。

self_pay.title: Maternal and infant RSV priced in the private market
self_pay.note: One pregnant user posts that she paid out of pocket for an RSV shot and was told the price would be higher after birth; this is a single post, not verified pricing.
self_pay.title_zh: 孕婦及嬰兒RSV自費市場價格
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高；此為單一貼文，價格未經查證。

self_pay.title: Little on clinic stock for enhanced flu or Tdap
self_pay.note: Rollout guides mention self-paid options alongside public doses and one report notes public shortage fears, but no item this week reports self-pay stock, prices or demand for adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所加強型流感或Tdap庫存資訊稀少
self_pay.note_zh: 接種指南於公費疫苗外一併提及自費選項，一篇報導提到民眾擔憂公費缺貨，但本週無內容報導含佐劑或高劑量流感疫苗或Tdap的自費庫存、價格或需求。
